english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone unwilling to work or make an effort.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is lazy or avoids doing work.

examples.english: I’m really lazy today; I don’t even want to go downstairs to buy anything.
examples.traditional: 我今日真係好懶，連落樓買嘢都唔想。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 laan5 lin4 lok6 lau4 maai5 je5 dou1 m4 soeng2

examples.english: They always say they’ll do it tomorrow, so they are really indolent.
examples.traditional: 佢成日話聽日先做，真係好懶。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 ting1 jat6 sin1 zou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 laan5
